gold_requirements.text: Citizens shall be able to register complaints with the police.
The system shall facilitate the investigation process by automating tasks after registration.
The system shall provide a platform to record entries of court interactions for prosecution.
The system shall allow police personnel to execute basic or advanced searches on cases, persons, crimes, modus operandi, and property.
The system shall allow users to customize search result views by criminal, accused, or case.
The system shall enable police to generate reports including monthly reporting and RTI related queries.
The system shall provide a citizen interface for information exchange and acknowledgements between citizens and police.
The system shall provide role-based landing pages showing assigned cases, alerts, and pending tasks.
The system must keep an unalterable audit trail of all create, read, update, and delete actions on critical entities.
The system must log unauthorized attempts to access cases in the audit trail.
The system must allow administrators to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.
The system must support role-based control for all system functionality.
The system must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.
The system must support SSL encrypted connections and secure virtual private network connections.
The system must use HTTPS as the communication protocol.
The system must prevent cross-site scripting, SQL injection, and validate/encode all incoming data.
The system must perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds.
The system must perform an advanced search within 10-15 seconds.
The time taken by the system must retrieve and display cases that have been accessed in the last 2 months within 5-8 seconds
The system must retrieve and display infrequently accessed cases within 20 seconds.
The system must provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all user interfaces.
The system must provide a single set of user interface rules to ensure a common look and feel.
The system must support multilingual interfaces.
The system must work in an offline mode for critical functionality.
The system must be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and modular design.
The system must support Single-Sign on for end-users.
The system must be designed for centralized deployment in a 3-tier datacenter architecture.
System should be designed for browser based use and must minimally use client device resources
